question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dumped**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is about the Boston Tea Party, an event where tea was thrown into the harbour as a protest.
 
• The blank refers to the amount of tea that ended up in the harbour during this event.
 
• "**Dumped**" is the most appropriate word, as it means tea was disposed of or thrown away, matching the historical context.
 
• Other options ("**upheld**", "**elevated**", "**fostered**") do not fit the context of tea being thrown into the harbour.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The volume of tea imports into the Colonies rose at a very fast rate in the four years following up to the Boston Tea Party. They went from 55 tonnes in 1770, which was close to the amount **dumped__** in the harbour, to 370 tonnes the year the tea was dumped. This was an increase of almost seven times. The population of the Colonies was about 2 million people in 1770 and didn’t change much in that four-year period. Basic economics tells us this sharp increase in supply without more customers meant the price of tea had to fall.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Upheld: Means supported or maintained, which is unrelated to the context.
 
• Elevated: Means raised or lifted, which does not describe the act of disposing tea.
 
• Fostered: Means encouraged or promoted, which does not fit the narrative of tea being thrown away.
